checks.name: Completed booking receives an opaque token and a real ten-hour delay
Reputation administration rejects customers and anonymous callers
French secure review page is server-rendered without private booking identity or contact data
Invalid tokens and other-customer booking access are rejected
Platform settings persist and reject unofficial redirect destinations
Concurrent queue runs create one localized branded test request with secure CTA and QR
Immediate reminders and manual spam resends are blocked
One delayed reminder is allowed and the maximum is enforced
Low-rating submission requires consent, prevents duplicate reviews and stops reminders without gating external options
Pending content is private and unique funnel events never fabricate delivery or external publication
Legitimate criticism can be published; public review payload excludes booking identifiers and private data
Public replies and private issue resolution persist with moderation history
Published tour reviews and official replies render in the initial server response
Landing-page and existing review-archive social proof use relationships without duplicating review records
Opt-out persists and blocks automatic/manual requests without blocking independent review choices
Secure-link photo upload and preview enforce completed-booking ownership
Photos need explicit consent and moderation before public display
Approved photo deletion revokes media access and removes it from public review data
Cancelled bookings revoke review link actions and QR generation
Localized review email templates are editable and persist after fresh reads
